messages:
marco: starting DB change window now — adding tenant_profile.new_bio (nullable) + backfill. release notes pushed to #release-notes. pin app image to 2.14.1 for this window. deploybot scheduled deploy in ~5m. watch for rowlock/idle-in-txns; if any lock >45s on main_user table we hit the holdpoint and pause rollout.

deploybot: scheduled deploy v2.14.1 to prod (canary 5%) — migration script attached: migrations/2026_add_new_bio.sql. next update in ~4m.
sarah: confirming: backfill runs as low-priority worker, but last run had a couple of long-running locks. @carmen can you take DB watch?
carmen: on it, tailing pg_stat_activity. currently seeing two sessions in "idle in transaction" on tenant_id=42 (pid 23456, 23460). pinging owners, will escalate to terminate if no response in 30s.
marco: holdpoint rule: any lock >45s on main_user -> pause deploy + call rollback playbook. rollback target: release-2.14.0. make sure rollback steps are in release notes.
rebecca: ack. preparing rollback steps: feature_flag migrate_new_profile=false, traffic pin to stable pool, rollback command: `redwood release rollback --to release-2.14.0`. adding to notes now.
oncall-bot: ALERT (info): /users p95 latency increased to 120ms in last 1m — likely backfill effect, not an outage.
carmen: terminated pid 23456 and 23460 after 30s warning. locks cleared. backfill resumed at low rate (~10 rows/s). ETA ~40m for full backfill. starting canary now.
sarah: canary 5% green for 3m, no errors surfaced in app logs. recommending proceed to 25%.
marco: proceed to 25%. update release notes with explicit rollback criteria: (1) >5% errors from canary, (2) p95 db latency +200ms, (3) any lock >60s on main_user. all agree?
deploybot: canary updated to 25% (ts=1776001280).
rebecca: setting up quick monitors: `kubectl logs -l app=profiles | grep -i "migration error"` and SQL check: `SELECT count(*) FROM migration_errors WHERE ts > now() - interval '5 minutes';` will page if >0.
carmen: seeing a transient duplicate key on insert (409) — backfill retried and idempotent, not blocking.
marco: decision thresholds reiterated: persistent dup errors >10/min OR p95 db latency >200ms -> abort and rollback. otherwise continue.
sarah: agree. dashboard monitor link: https://console.redwood/dashboards/migrate-174 (I'll keep an eye and DM ops if threshold crossed).
rebecca: :thumbsup: updated release-notes with rollback commands and the holdpoint timestamp window.
deploybot: final rollout to 100% scheduled in 15m unless aborted.
carmen: small spike in rowlock wait for tenant 88 at 1776001370 — peaked ~50s and resolved, no action.
marco: excellent. if stable for next 10m we close the window. thanks team.
